sqlite:
CREATE TABLE courses (
	creator_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	needs_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE course_versions (
	course_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	audience VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	objectives JSON NOT NULL, 
	duration INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pass_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	storyboard JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (course_id, number), 
	CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','PUBLISHED','REJECTED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_course_versions_course_id ON course_versions (course_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_course_versions_status ON course_versions (status)

CREATE TABLE course_sources (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, document_version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE lessons (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	objective TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	key_points JSON NOT NULL, 
	citation_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_lessons_course_version_id ON lessons (course_version_id)

CREATE TABLE checklists (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (course_version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE checklist_items (
	checklist_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	critical BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	citation_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(checklist_id) REFERENCES checklists (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_checklist_items_checklist_id ON checklist_items (checklist_id)

CREATE TABLE quizzes (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (course_version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE quiz_questions (
	quiz_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	question TEXT NOT NULL, 
	correct INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	explanation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	difficulty VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	citation_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (correct >= 0 AND correct <= 3), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quiz_id) REFERENCES quizzes (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_quiz_questions_quiz_id ON quiz_questions (quiz_id)

CREATE TABLE answer_options (
	question_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(question_id) REFERENCES quiz_questions (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_answer_options_question_id ON answer_options (question_id)

CREATE TABLE content_approvals (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	comment TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
